name: dsir-ghe
description: Discover and retrieve WHO Global Health Estimates with exact countries, causes, years, sex, age, measures, units and provenance.

interface.longDescription: Discover causes and dimensions, retrieve WHO GHE estimates, and export verified CSV/JSON. Use the AI host's Python 3.10+ and permitted HTTPS; no R, DSIR, third-party package, API key or DSIR server. All-age rates are crude and selected-age rates are age-specific. No automatic age standardization or source substitution.
defaultPrompt: Get all-cause deaths in the Philippines for the latest available year.
Compare female and male mortality rates at ages 40-44 in the Philippines.
Find available GHE causes and measures for diabetes.
